It can be found in 1 of 2 locations in the northwest building of the train depot. The depot can only be accessed via the [[BTR Driver]]'s taxi service. After collecting the package, you have to hand it over to Prapor in his quest [[Shipping Delay - Part 1]], afterwards you can complete this quest.
